title: Touhou Kaikidan ~ Mystic Square - Wondrous Romance ~ Mystic Square (Remix)
description:
𝓘 𝓳𝓾𝓼𝓽 𝓭𝓸𝓷'𝓽 𝓽𝓱𝓲𝓷𝓴 𝓪𝓫𝓸𝓾𝓽 𝓵𝓸𝓼𝓲𝓷𝓰. 𝓘𝓯 𝓘'𝓶 𝓯𝓲𝓰𝓱𝓽𝓲𝓷𝓰 𝔂𝓸𝓾 𝔀𝓲𝓽𝓱 𝓹𝓪𝓻𝓵𝓸𝓻 𝓽𝓻𝓲𝓬𝓴𝓼, 𝓽𝓱𝓮𝓷 𝔂𝓸𝓾'𝓵𝓵 𝓱𝓪𝓿𝓮 𝓷𝓸 𝓮𝔁𝓬𝓾𝓼𝓮 𝓯𝓸𝓻 𝓵𝓸𝓼𝓲𝓷𝓰, 𝔀𝓲𝓵𝓵 𝔂𝓸𝓾?

A remix of Wondrous Romance ~ Mystic Square from Touhou Kaikidan ~ Mystic Square. This was used as that game's title theme. Been wanting to do this remix ever since I did Gensokyo ~ Lotus Land Story a couple months back but had other songs / ports to prioritize first.

This baby can fit in title screens, sky, space, and night stages.

Note:
- There are two customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the song file:
- E Minor (Original Pitch, set by default)
- F Minor (Custom Pitch)
